# Principal source-sufficiency assessment B

Mimimi, Tama and Yuzu each have sufficient positive, contrasting and countervailing evidence to **recommend a separately authorized bounded construction decision** in the domains below. This is an assessment of source support, not construction admission, authored behavior, model validation, a global capability grade or owner calibration. The old planning identifiers MR-P03/MR-P05/MR-P07 are navigation only and supply no persona pass. Root owns any later individual admission.

The boundary is the fourteen admitted Japanese witnesses through V12, with supplements kept at their story-local clocks. The three current complete monographs equal the released Edition 1 path@b498a20457e4debeb70895fca8ebd37717e91017 instances. The actual Edition 1 decision satisfies the literary prerequisite and explicitly awards no individual model gate. Current architecture16/17.2 requires state, relationship, knowledge and stakes before behavioral inference, traceable dependencies, negative constraints and independent review. No primary source was reopened for this assessment.

## Mimimi / Nanami Minami

**Recommended construction domain:** familiar school-peer and close-friend interaction, low-stakes leisure and sensory practice, bounded competitive comparison, the separately witnessed romantic/non-selection states, selected collaborative/public novice roles and V12 contribution/critique. Each is a conditional domain rather than one final personality state.

The evidence supports operational attention and competing ends. In ordinary company she wants lively exchange and a particular response, likes noisy fun, food and running, and can seek directions or try tea differently. Those wants contradict a model that explains every joke as defensive labor or every kindness as a bid for indispensability. In a valued comparative field, however, another person's improving result can become a moving condition of her own worth. The process-valued running story makes sensory attention and a local rematch refusal available without erasing a desire to win. In the Tama relation, gladness at her friend's growth can exceed reduced-need sadness; this is evidence against deliberate dependence maintenance, not proof the sadness vanished. [Monograph §§2–6,9; NM-E01–09/E26; ensemble §§3–8; CS §9]

The clocks are load bearing. V03 camp respect is not already V06 romantic love. The immediate post-declaration digital checking is private acute aftermath, not a heard disclosure or stable surveillance policy. V07 friendship continuity after non-selection preserves love and future emotional freedom. The private year-end V08.5 conversation belongs between V07 and V08; Fumiya does not acquire its full contents. V09 gives a concrete local separation, about a week of altered walks, actual resumption initiated over protest, and a later distinct assent to brief continued leaning. V11 novice commentary is a public collaboration with bounded exposure and extended work, not a vocation or gaming expertise. V12's addressed ethical self-regard strengthens earlier V09 self-liking and adds no first-ever agency or completed contact policy. [Monograph §§3,7–8,10,14,17; NM-P12–28/P30; REL §7/§17; JVL §6/§13]

Mimimi can propose a bodily interview method, run competitively, attend to another participant's breath, challenge a draft and help public work. The same source also gives impulsive pressure, unfair indirect inquiry and neglected event preparation. Her reasonable defense of message-bearing fiction is a contributor's argument; Kikuchi owns the later stop. Hinami's private inferior-copy portrait cannot become current Mimimi authority, and composed Nana speech cannot become another real interview or a shared reconciliation. A model must distinguish chosen self-regard, continuing desire, valuable help and displaced responsibilities. [Monograph §17.3–17.7; ensemble §16; CS §19; EFF §§82–84]

**Field disposition:** supported for conditional attention, ordinary wants, positive capacities, local refusal and recipient variation; restricted for high-pressure self-worth predictions, bodily/contact stopping, private inquiry and cost distribution; unestablished for a complete future romance rule, replacement support arrangement, chosen profession, new severe comparison outcome or a full idiolect. The monograph's preserved hypothetical probes are exposed literary reasoning, not held-out validation or an already constructed model.

**Voice limit:** local joking orthography, role nicknames, hesitant disclosure, hedged restraint and serious specifications/self contrast can constrain prose. They do not license a recipe of elongated vowels, universal flirtation, invented exact quotations, acoustic claims or transplanting private narration into spoken knowledge. The model should have ordinary low-stakes action available without making every reply a speech about self-worth. [Monograph §10/§17.7; JVL §§6/13; voice specialist §6]

**Broader-domain debt:** a new equivalent severe dyadic disagreement, an actual enduring contact agreement, a tested response to unwanted help being refused, a settled occupation or a new physical-separation arrangement would need new evidence. No hidden source answer is asserted. Those fields can remain excluded while the defined construction domain proceeds if root separately admits it.

## Tama / Natsubayashi Hanabi

**Recommended construction domain:** familiar friendship, selected participation and reciprocal expression teaching; bounded V05 learner/recipient adaptation; ordinary sweets/craft and service work under witnessed family-shop standing; current self-binding and distributed cost as restricted constraints.

Tama's positive agency is wider than blunt correctness. She likes the shop's sweets and work before the V12 remake, learns product quality from family, accepts/declines particular activities, quietly arranges food and waits outside private conversation. With Fumiya she gives direct thanks and asks him to accept them, teaches an expression and distinguishes capture from upload permission. With unfamiliar Mizusawa she can suspend a whole-person judgment while retaining an actual prior objection. Service politeness, family embarrassment, after-hours plain speech and particular care prevent one invariant register. [Monograph §§3,5–10; TH-P02–07; CS §10; ensemble §§3,5,7]

V05 is an interaction under harassment, not a fair free-choice laboratory. Copied training fails because her expression, goals and hostile reception differ from Fumiya's. Later distributed help changes means while she retains the end and refusal authority. Her stopping of reverse persecution keeps the injured target's agency visible without conferring forgiveness, Konno's apology, complete justice or permanent safety. Akiyama/group's separate apology remains direct and actor specific. A new hostile-recipient retest is absent. [Monograph §§6–8/12/16; TH-P01/03; CS §§10/20; ensemble §5]

V12 adds practiced service, a damaged birthday cake, a real customer benefit and competing legitimate costs. Her care for one child's unique day coexists with the mother's initial release from further effort, staff and queue burdens, a visitor's labor and acknowledged manager-family latitude. Her borrowed hero ideal becomes owned through repeated acts, yet some compromises feel like self-betrayal. This supports contextual competing ends, not a universal moral-remake rule or a diagnosis. Method flexibility, earlier nonparticipation and privacy waiting refute permanent rigidity; costs and privilege refute natural purity. [Monograph §15; TH-P08; CS §19; EFF §82; voice specialist §10]

**Field disposition:** supported for task/recipient-conditioned attention, practical skill and ordinary wants, known learning/refusal choices and anti-collective-cruelty consistency; restricted for self-defining cost conflicts and behavior outside supportive fields; unestablished for shop succession, wages/management authority, guaranteed hostile-classroom resilience, a universal compromise rule or her unshown answer to Mimimi's separation concern. No future-care promise may be generated for a conversation she is not shown hearing.

**Voice limit:** direct compact expression, particular recognition, a learned public opening, fluent service and addressed self-criticism are distinct local forms. The neighboring employee's first reassuring apology is not Tama's later wait apology. No automatic curt moral correction, comprehensive idiolect, diagnosis from 歪んでる or new dialogue transcription follows. [Monograph §§9.3/15–16; JVL §§7/13; voice specialist §10]

**Broader-domain debt:** a real work disagreement under less family privilege, negotiated distribution of a costly standard, revision of a self-defining end rather than delivery, occupational choice and a new severe hostile-recipient test are not supplied. Exclude those predictions instead of forcing a broad persona.

## Yuzu / Izumi Yuzu

**Recommended construction domain:** relationship-motivated skill learning; familiar peer coordination and timing-sensitive inquiry; selected public festival work; ordinary taste and friend consultation; birthday/event work under partial information; separately placed V11–V12 participation and burden states.

Yuzu has chosen ends. She learns a game for a desired relation while supplying social knowledge in return; chooses festival-chair work; makes actual discreet inquiries; enjoys fashion judgment and photographic skill; and voices an educational preference with familiar joking. These are not merely services for other people's plots. Her Aogaku wish is her report and preference, not admission, financial feasibility, a model career or independently verified biography. Chosen affiliation can coexist with pressure and imperfectly distributed labor. [Monograph §§2–9/15–18; IY-R01/02/04/05/11; CS §12; ensemble §§2/14]

Her valued ties are not interchangeable. Konno friendship and practical help coexist with Yuzu's judgment that prior harassment was wrong. Ordinary re-entry is different from another actor's apology and unfinished restitution. Story-local V06.5 fear of a breakup is private focalization, not the actual purpose of Nakamura's meeting and not Fumiya's knowledge. The phone sequence keeps initial taking and later assent to sending separate; photograph interpretation remains partial. Early learner, later collaborator and public organizer need different information/standing selectors. [Monograph §16.1–16.3/18; IY-R01–06; Konno dossier §8; CS §§12/20]

The birthday plan carries remembered care and received pleasure while lacking access to Hinami's hidden family trigger. A model must preserve sincerity, competence, access and result separately. V11 Yuzu reports the absent council handoff and begins self-blame; Nakamura refuses cooperation partly in protest at her burden, and she chooses to follow. His refusal does not become her own universal capacity threshold. V12 delivery demonstrates changed participation, not the missing private reconciliation agreement; her final wave is visible and her words unheard. [Monograph §16.4–16.5/17–20; IY-R07–10; REL §17; ensemble §§14–16]

**Field disposition:** supported for concrete familiar coordination, recipient-specific care and ordinary positive preferences; restricted for private self-theory, responsibility under guilt and new burdens; unestablished for a stable absorber/delegation threshold, complete partner reciprocity, hidden family knowledge, career selection, future household roles or unfamiliar professional management. No invariant priority ranking of Nakamura against every friend/duty is supported.

**Voice limit:** softened reluctance can be a real refusal, and cheerful facilitation can be deliberate action. Brightness supplies neither easy compliance nor proof of costlessness. Local educational banter differs from the council guilt sequence, and unheard V12 words cannot be invented as reassurance. No comprehensive particle, pitch, honorific or private-family-voice model is available. [Monograph §19; JVL §9/§13; voice specialist §12]

**Broader-domain debt:** a witnessed decision to refuse/delegate a severe new burden, an enduring couple/council labor agreement or selected vocation would discriminate among current alternatives. Their absence does not prevent bounded familiar-role construction; it prevents confident completion of those fields.

## Assessment and next responsibility

The recommendation is based on distinct acts, competing ends, changed situations and adverse cases, rather than the literary maturity label, paragraph count or trait vocabulary. Supported ordinary agency is an affirmative requirement: a proposed model must help select bounded practical actions in an ordinary supported field as well as withhold unknown facts. Restricted fields should retain alternatives or abstain, rather than quietly substitute what the reviewer thinks the person ought to do.

If root separately admits construction, each model needs the architecture's explicit dependencies and state/recipient/knowledge order; a preregistered evaluation design before output; honest known-canon versus hypothetical exposure records; actual independent semantic and selective Japanese prose/register assessment; material errors and targeted revisions/retests preserved. No accuracy percentage, blind prediction success, general voice authenticity, global grade or owner calibration is inferred here.

The full three monographs were actually read. Mimimi's initial combined bands clipped lines88–125 and229–237; both were explicitly recovered, and all1–1606 lines were subsequently covered. Tama1–362 and Yuzu1–338 were displayed in two complete contiguous bands each. Loadbearing ensemble/cumulative/voice windows are enumerated and hashed in the input record. All six pilot/principal literary identities equal the fixed register, including the three pilot dossiers previously read fully. Source locators inside these mature inputs are inherited evidence routes, not new primary inspection by this reviewer. No new image, audio, primary acquisition or whole-book reread occurred. A bounded name/reference review covers each person's introduction, ordinary agency, relational/permission controls and current boundary: named actors, speakers and recipients remain distinct; no material attribution defect was retained.
